items.title: 9.3 Ionic product of water (pani ka ionic product) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.3 with Table 9.2, printed pages 192-193.

blocks.text: Pure (khalis) pani electricity (bijli) ka poor (kamzor) conductor hai, lekin us ki conductance napi ja sakti hai. Pani khud hi thora sa ionize hota hai (self-ionization), aur yeh reaction reversible hai:
Is reaction ka equilibrium constant yeh hai:

Pure pani mein pani ki concentration [H₂O] = 1000 g dm⁻³ ÷ 18 g mol⁻¹ = 55.5 mol dm⁻³ hai. Pani bohat zyada amount mein hai aur us ke bohat thore molecules ionize hote hain, is liye us ki concentration taqreeban constant rehti hai. Is constant concentration ko baen taraf (L.H.S.) le ja kar Kc se multiply (zarb) karte hain to ek naya constant milta hai jise Kw kehte hain.
Yeh 1.01 × 10⁻¹⁴ 25°C par pani ka Kw kehlata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne “Kw [H₂O] = [H⁺][OH⁻]” likha hai. Kw mein [H₂O] pehle hi shamil hai; sahi: Kw = Kc[H₂O] = [H⁺][OH⁻] = 10⁻¹⁴ (25°C par).

blocks.title: Pani ka ionic product
blocks.text: Kw ko pani ka ionic product ya pani ka dissociation constant kehte hain.
Temperature 0°C se 100°C karne par Kw ki value taqreeban 75 guna barh jati hai.

blocks.text_alt: [H⁺] = [OH⁻]; or [H⁺][H⁺] = 10⁻¹⁴; [H⁺]² = 10⁻¹⁴ (at 25°C); [H⁺] = 10⁻⁷ mol dm⁻³ and [OH⁻] = 10⁻⁷ mol dm⁻³

blocks.text: Temperature ka Kw par asar Table 9.2 mein hai. Jab pani mein thora acid ya base dala jaye to Kw wahi rehta hai, lekin [H⁺] aur [OH⁻] barabar nahi rehte.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Table 9.2 mein power 10¹⁴ chhapi hai. 25°C par Kw = 1.0 × 10⁻¹⁴ hai, is liye sahi values 0.11, 0.30, 1.0, 3.00 aur 7.5 × 10⁻¹⁴ hain.
Base ke few drops (chand qatre) dalne par:
Dono cases mein Kw ki value wahi rehti hai, yani 25°C par 10⁻¹⁴.

blocks.prompt: [H₂O] ko constant mein kyun shamil kiya jata hai, aur 25°C par pani mein thora acid dalne se [H⁺] aur [OH⁻] ko kya hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Pani ki concentration 55.5 mol dm⁻³ hai aur bohat kam molecules ionize hote hain, is liye [H₂O] taqreeban constant hai; Kc × 55.5 = Kw = 1.01 × 10⁻¹⁴. Acid dalne se [H⁺] 10⁻⁷ se zyada ho jata hai. Product (zarb ka jawab) [H⁺][OH⁻] phir bhi 10⁻¹⁴ rehna chahiye, is liye [OH⁻] 10⁻⁷ se kam ho jata hai.

items: H₂O ⇌ H⁺ + OH⁻; Kc = 1.8 × 10⁻¹⁶, [H₂O] = 55.5 mol dm⁻³, to Kw = Kc[H₂O] = [H⁺][OH⁻] = 1.01 × 10⁻¹⁴ (25°C).
Kw ko pani ka ionic product kehte hain; 0°C se 100°C tak yeh taqreeban 75 guna barhta hai (Table 9.2).
Neutral pani: [H⁺] = [OH⁻] = 10⁻⁷ mol dm⁻³. Acid ya base dalne se yeh barabar nahi rehte, magar Kw wahi rehta hai.
